title: Immunity from liability.
bodyText: Any health care professional or laboratory director who complies with this part shall not be held civilly or criminally liable for providing the information required under this part.
bodyHtml: [§321-316]  Immunity from liability.  Any health care professional or laboratory director who complies with this part shall not be held civilly or criminally liable for providing the information required under this part. [L 1987, c 186, pt of §2]
